metadata.prompt: Superhero movies (Marvel and DC films). Questions about superhero films: characters, actors, plots, release years. Tie each question to a specific film so it has one answer
metadata.focus: Questions about superhero films: characters, actors, plots, release years. Tie each question to a specific film so it has one answer.

questions.question: Which actor played Tony Stark in the 2008 film 'Iron Man'?
questions.explanation: Robert Downey Jr. starred as Tony Stark in 'Iron Man' (2008), the film that launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
questions.fact: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark / Iron Man in the 2008 film 'Iron Man'.

questions.question: In 'Avengers: Infinity War' (2018), which villain seeks to collect all six Infinity Stones?
questions.explanation: Thanos is the main antagonist of 'Avengers: Infinity War' and gathers the Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life.
questions.fact: In 'Avengers: Infinity War' (2018), Thanos seeks all six Infinity Stones.

questions.question: The 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel' is mainly set in which decade?
questions.explanation: 'Captain Marvel' is set in 1995, which is why Samuel L. Jackson was digitally de-aged for the film.
questions.fact: The film 'Captain Marvel' (2019) is set in 1995.

questions.question: In the 2019 DC film 'Shazam!', which actor plays the adult superhero form of Billy Batson?
questions.explanation: Zachary Levi plays the adult superhero, while Asher Angel plays the teenage Billy Batson.
questions.fact: Zachary Levi stars as the adult superhero form of Billy Batson in 'Shazam!' (2019).

questions.question: Which actor played the Joker in Tim Burton's 1989 film 'Batman'?
questions.explanation: Jack Nicholson played the Joker opposite Michael Keaton's Batman in the 1989 film.
questions.fact: Jack Nicholson played the Joker in Tim Burton's 'Batman' (1989).

questions.question: Which directing duo directed the 2019 Marvel Studios film 'Captain Marvel'?
questions.explanation: Anna Boden and Ryan Fleck directed 'Captain Marvel' and co-wrote its screenplay with Geneva Robertson-Dworet.
questions.fact: 'Captain Marvel' (2019) was directed by Anna Boden and Ryan Fleck.

questions.question: Which actor played Peter Parker in Sam Raimi's 2002 film 'Spider-Man'?
questions.explanation: Tobey Maguire starred as Peter Parker in Sam Raimi's 2002 'Spider-Man' and its two sequels.
questions.fact: Tobey Maguire played Peter Parker in the 2002 film 'Spider-Man' directed by Sam Raimi.

questions.question: Which actor played the Joker in Christopher Nolan's 2008 film 'The Dark Knight'?
questions.explanation: Heath Ledger played the Joker in 'The Dark Knight' and won a posthumous Academy Award for the role.
questions.fact: Heath Ledger portrayed the Joker in the 2008 film 'The Dark Knight'.

questions.question: Which actress played the title role in the 2017 DC film 'Wonder Woman'?
questions.explanation: Gal Gadot played Diana in Patty Jenkins' 2017 film 'Wonder Woman'.
questions.fact: Gal Gadot starred as Wonder Woman in the 2017 film 'Wonder Woman'.

questions.question: In the 2019 DC film 'Shazam!', which actor plays the villain Dr. Thaddeus Sivana?
questions.explanation: Mark Strong plays Dr. Thaddeus Sivana, while Djimon Hounsou plays the wizard Shazam.
questions.fact: Mark Strong played Dr. Thaddeus Sivana in the 2019 film 'Shazam!'.

questions.question: In the 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel', which actor plays the Skrull leader Talos?
questions.explanation: Ben Mendelsohn plays Talos, while Jude Law plays the Kree commander Yon-Rogg.
questions.fact: Ben Mendelsohn played the Skrull Talos in the 2019 film 'Captain Marvel'.

questions.question: The 2019 film 'Captain Marvel' is which numbered film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.explanation: 'Captain Marvel' came after 'Ant-Man and the Wasp' (20th) and before 'Avengers: Endgame' (22nd), making it the 21st MCU film.
questions.fact: 'Captain Marvel' (2019) is the 21st film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

questions.question: Which actor played T'Challa in the 2018 Marvel film 'Black Panther'?
questions.explanation: Chadwick Boseman played T'Challa, first in 'Captain America: Civil War' and then in the 2018 solo film 'Black Panther'.
questions.fact: Chadwick Boseman starred as T'Challa in 'Black Panther' (2018).

questions.question: Which actor played Bruce Wayne in Christopher Nolan's 2005 film 'Batman Begins'?
questions.explanation: Christian Bale played Batman in all three films of Nolan's trilogy, starting with 'Batman Begins' in 2005.
questions.fact: Christian Bale played Bruce Wayne in 'Batman Begins' (2005).

questions.question: In the 2019 DC film 'Shazam!', what is the name of Billy Batson's superhero-obsessed foster brother?
questions.explanation: Freddy Freeman, played by Jack Dylan Grazer, helps Billy discover his new powers.
questions.fact: In 'Shazam!' (2019), Billy Batson's foster brother is Freddy Freeman, played by Jack Dylan Grazer.

questions.question: In the 2019 Marvel film 'Captain Marvel', which actor plays Yon-Rogg, Carol Danvers' Kree commander?
questions.explanation: Jude Law plays Yon-Rogg, the commander of the Kree Starforce team that Carol Danvers belongs to.
questions.fact: Jude Law plays Yon-Rogg in 'Captain Marvel' (2019).

questions.question: In the 2019 DC film 'Shazam!', the villain Dr. Thaddeus Sivana draws his power from which group of demonic beings?
questions.explanation: Sivana becomes the host of the Seven Deadly Sins, demons that were imprisoned by the wizard Shazam.
questions.fact: In 'Shazam!' (2019), Dr. Thaddeus Sivana is empowered by the Seven Deadly Sins.

questions.question: Principal photography for the 2019 DC film 'Shazam!' took place mainly in which city?
questions.explanation: Filming began in Toronto in January 2018, with most of the movie shot at Pinewood Toronto Studios.
questions.fact: Principal photography on 'Shazam!' began in Toronto on January 29, 2018, mostly at Pinewood Toronto Studios.
